title: Water Backup and Sump Discharge or Overflow

clauses.heading: Water Backup and Sump Discharge or Overflow > Coverage
clauses.text: We insure for direct physical loss, not caused by the negligence of an “insured”, to property covered under Section I caused by water, or waterborne material, which backs up through sewers or drains or overflows or is discharged from a sump, sump pump or related equipment, even if such overflow or discharge results from mechanical breakdown of the sump pump or related equipment. This coverage does not apply to direct physical loss of the sump pump or related equipment itself that is caused by mechanical breakdown.

clauses.heading: Water Backup and Sump Discharge or Overflow > Exclusion Changed
clauses.text: With respect to the coverage provided by this endorsement, paragraph 3.b of the Water exclusion in Section I - Exclusions is deleted.

clauses.heading: Water Backup and Sump Discharge or Overflow > Power Failure
clauses.text: With respect to the coverage provided by this endorsement, the Power Failure exclusion in Section I - Exclusions does not apply when the backup or overflow results from the failure of power to a sump pump, even if the failure of power takes place off the “residence premises”.

clauses.heading: Water Backup and Sump Discharge or Overflow > Flood Not Covered
clauses.text: This endorsement does not cover loss caused by or resulting from water described in paragraph 3.a or 3.c of the Water exclusion, including flood or surface water that enters a sewer, drain or sump and then backs up or is discharged into the building. Such loss remains excluded.

clauses.heading: Water Backup and Sump Discharge or Overflow > Limit of Liability
clauses.text: The most we will pay in any one loss under this endorsement is the Water Backup limit shown in the Declarations, or $5,000 if no limit is shown. This limit is included in, and does not increase, the limits of liability for Coverages A, B and C.

clauses.heading: Water Backup and Sump Discharge or Overflow > Deductible
clauses.text: With respect to loss covered by this endorsement, the Water Backup deductible shown in the Declarations replaces the Section I deductible. If no Water Backup deductible is shown, the Section I deductible applies.

clauses.heading: Water Backup and Sump Discharge or Overflow > Other Provisions
clauses.text: All other provisions of this policy apply, including the duty to protect property from further damage. Loss caused by the failure of an “insured” to maintain a sump pump in working order, or to repair a known defect in a drain or sewer connection, is caused by negligence and is not covered by this endorsement.
